```sql
        UpdatedDate datetime Null,
        UpdatedBy nvarchar(100) Null,
        Constraint PK_INFO_AboutPageContent Primary Key Clustered
        (

If Not Exists

    (
        PageCode,

        ContentCode,
        LanguageID
    )
End
Go
```

```sql

    @LanguageID int,

End
```
Go

Create Procedure dbo.INFO_AboutPageContent_SearchCMS
    @PageCode nvarchar(50) = Null,
    @SectionCode nvarchar(100) = Null,
    @Keyword nvarchar(200) = Null,
    @IsPublished int = Null
As
Begin
    Set NoCount On

    Select
        AboutPageContentID,
        PageCode,
        SectionCode,
        ContentCode,
        ContentType,
        TitleVi,
        TitleEn,
        ContentVi,
        ContentEn,
        ImageUrl,
        LinkUrl,
        NumberValue,
        NumberSuffix,
        SortOrder,
        IsPublished,
        CreatedDate,
        CreatedBy,
        UpdatedDate,
        UpdatedBy
    From
        dbo.INFO_AboutPageContent
    Where
        IsDeleted = 0
        And
        (
            @PageCode Is Null
            Or PageCode = @PageCode
        )
        And
        (
            @SectionCode Is Null
            Or SectionCode = @SectionCode
        )
        And
        (
            @IsPublished Is Null
            Or IsPublished = @IsPublished
        )
        And
        (
            @Keyword Is Null
            Or @Keyword = N''
            Or ContentCode Like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
            Or SectionCode Like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
            Or IsNull(TitleVi, N'') Like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
            Or IsNull(TitleEn, N'') Like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
            Or IsNull(ContentVi, N'') Like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
            Or IsNull(ContentEn, N'') Like N'%' + @Keyword + N'%'
        )
    Order By
        SectionCode,
        SortOrder,
        ContentCode
End
Go
